caption: Agent Artifact
description: A digest-anchored element of an AI agent's trust base: model weights, an adapter, a tool schema, a policy bundle, or the agent's charter. The fingerprint is a content digest of the artifact bytes, or of the canonical serialization of a remotely served schema. For remotely served elements, uid names the source (for example an MCP server URI); for registry artifacts, uid names the registry entry.
name: agent_artifact

name.description: The artifact name. For example: refunds-tone-lora or billing-tools.

uid.description: The artifact source identifier: a registry entry, artifact store path, or remote source URI such as an MCP server address.

version.description: The artifact version identifier, as declared by its source.

1.caption: Model Weights
1.description: A locally loaded model artifact, such as a weights file.

2.caption: Adapter
2.description: A model adapter, such as a LoRA.

3.caption: Tool Schema
3.description: A tool or resource schema as presented to the model, such as an MCP tools/list result.

4.caption: Policy Bundle
4.description: A policy or guardrail bundle governing the agent.

5.caption: Charter
5.description: The agent's charter document, when not carried on ai_agent.charter.

type.description: The artifact type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of Other, it is defined by the source.

fingerprint.description: The content digest anchoring this artifact. The algorithm and serialization siblings state the actual construction; a producer that cannot obtain the true artifact bytes omits the fingerprint rather than digesting a proxy.
